snippet_primary: "If you are not satisfied with the content within the first 14 calendar days of purchasing a course, Domestika will refund the full amount and revoke your access to the course. Refunds will not be accepted after this 14-day period. If you purchased a course using Plus credits, you may exchange it for another course of your choice, but refunds are not permitted."
subject_exact: Domestika's 14-day refund window for course purchases, with Plus-credit purchases restricted to exchange only
time_scope_raw: within the first 14 calendar days of purchasing a course
local_qualifiers: if purchased using Plus credits, exchange only, no refunds permitted
